title: Trend Card
description: Stage-4 concept-centric trend extraction across a sub-area (a thread of papers, not a single paper). Captures how the field is shifting along problem/method/representation/assumption/evaluation/resource dimensions, what failure modes recur, whether the field explains WHY or only reports THAT, and where the reader's own opportunity lies. Source-grounded in source_refs.

scope.description: the sub-area / thread this trend covers (e.g. 'foundation-model adaptation for thin-structure 3D segmentation')

shifts.description: directional shifts the field is undergoing, one per dimension

dimension.description: which axis the field is shifting along

from.description: what the field used to do on this dimension

to.description: what the field is moving toward on this dimension

failure_modes.description: recurring failure modes the sub-area keeps running into

mechanism_vs_result.description: does the field explain WHY methods work (mechanism) or merely report THAT they work (result)?

reproducibility_trend.description: whether reproducibility in this sub-area is improving, stagnant, or worsening — null if not assessed

opportunities.description: your-opportunity extraction — open white space the reader could own
